description.value: UCHU Cevicheria & Raw Bar is a Peruvian coastal seafood restaurant in Vancouver's Chinatown, helmed by Chef Ricardo Valverde, whose culinary vision draws on Peru's ceviche traditions fused with Japanese Nikkei and Chinese Chifa influences. The intimate 68-seat dining room is anchored by a Raw Bar and open kitchen, with exposed brick and blue upholstery evoking the oceanside cevicherias of Peru. Sister restaurant to SUYO, UCHU represents Valverde's second exploration of his Peruvian heritage in Vancouver's culinary scene.
